question:
Select the word that is similar in meaning to the underlined word.

My boss maintained a very __parochial__ view of the world.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Narrow'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word is** "parochial,"** meaning having a limited or narrow view or scope, often related to local concerns or interests (संकीर्ण).
 
• The correct word with similar meaning is **"Narrow,"** which also denotes something restricted in extent, amount, or scope (संकीर्ण).
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **'Narrow'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Option 3: **"Harmonious"** means forming a pleasing or consistent whole (सामंजस्यपूर्ण).
 
• Option 4: **"Laughing"** describes expressing amusement or joy through laughter (हंसते हुए).
